title: Hundredth monkey effect on Japanese islands

tellings.quote: island of monkeys certain type of monkey I think it's in Japan that they have a species of monkeys that's separated by an island

plain: The "hundredth monkey effect" is the idea that once enough monkeys on one island in Japan learned a new behaviour, monkeys of the same kind on separate islands began doing it too, as if knowledge spread without contact. Randy Anderson, a guest who says he saw alien technology on a military base, brings it up with Michels, recalling it loosely: "I think it's in Japan, they have a species of monkeys that's separated by an island."
